gold: Cutaneous Langerhans cell histiocytosis (LCH) with concurrent evolving acute myeloid leukemia (AML)

selector.rationale: The presence of a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells positive for CD207/langerin and negative for myeloperoxidase strongly supports Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

rejected.label: BRAF-V600E-positive melanocytic neoplasm
rejected.why: The biopsy specimen did not demonstrate features typical of a melanocytic neoplasm.

rejected.label: ASXL1-mutated neoplasm
rejected.why: While ASXL1 mutations were identified, they are not specific to this diagnosis and are also seen in myelodysplastic syndromes.

rejected.label: IDH2-mutated neoplasm
rejected.why: Similar to ASXL1, IDH2 mutations are present but not diagnostic on their own for this condition.
